translation.landing.tagline: Private offline personal finance tracking for expenses, budgets, wallets, and monthly reports.
translation.landing.featuresSubtitle: Designed for local-first expense tracking, budget control, wallet management, and financial visibility.
translation.landing.featurePrivacyDesc: Financial data stays in IndexedDB on your device. No account or remote finance database is required.
translation.landing.featureSpeedDesc: Track expenses, balances, transfers, and budgets without waiting on a server.
translation.landing.featureNativeDesc: Integrates into your OS like a built-in app.
translation.landing.featureOfflineDesc: Works offline after the first successful load and service worker cache.
translation.landing.trustStatement: No registration, no required server account, and no automatic cloud sync.
translation.landing.installSubtitle: Install in under 30 seconds. No registration required.
translation.landing.iosManualStep: Safari on iOS requires a quick manual step to add Expend to your home screen.
translation.landing.browserInstallOption: Experience Expend as a full application via your browser's install option.
translation.landing.step1IosDesc: Tap the Share button in Safari.
translation.landing.step1BrowserDesc: Open the browser menu (three dots icon).
translation.landing.step1IosVisual: At the bottom of the screen
translation.landing.step2Desc: Scroll down and select Add to Home Screen.
translation.landing.installNote: PWA will appear on your home screen like a native app.
translation.landing.faq1Answer: Your data is stored locally on your device using IndexedDB and is not sent to any server. PINs are hashed with PBKDF2 for screen lock verification; the PIN lock does not encrypt financial data at rest.
translation.landing.faq2Question: Can I use it without internet?
translation.landing.faq2Answer: Yes. Expend can work offline after the first successful online load and service worker cache. Local data stays available on the current device.
translation.landing.faq3Answer: Open Expend in Safari, tap the Share button, then select Add to Home Screen.
translation.landing.faq4Answer: Yes, Expend is free and the source is publicly available. No premium features, no ads, no registration.
translation.landing.faq5Answer: Go to Settings > Data > Export JSON. The backup file can be imported anytime to restore your data.
translation.landing.featureWalletDesc: Manage multiple wallets simultaneously. Track each wallet's balance accurately.
translation.landing.featureBudgetDesc: Set monthly budgets per category. Get alerts when approaching the limit.
translation.landing.featureTransferDesc: Move funds between wallets with automatic recording on both sides.
translation.landing.featureChartsDesc: Interactive pie, line, and bar charts with drill-down into individual transactions.
translation.landing.featureSearchDesc: Full-text search with advanced filters and visual highlighting.
translation.landing.featureSecurityDesc: Screen lock with PBKDF2-hashed PIN. Auto-lock after idle.
translation.landing.featureLanguageDesc: Available in Indonesian and English with automatic detection.
translation.landing.techSubtitle: A modern local-first stack for offline PWA delivery, IndexedDB storage, charts, and screen-lock security.
translation.landing.techReactDesc: Modern component architecture with type safety
translation.landing.techPwaDesc: Installable, offline-first app shell with service worker caching
translation.landing.techSecurityDesc: Screen-lock PIN hashing with PBKDF2 through the Web Crypto API
translation.landing.techChartsDesc: Interactive data visualization and declarative animations
translation.landing.techBuildDesc: Fast builds, utility-first styling, instant dark mode
translation.landing.previewSubtitle: Designed for optimal readability in all conditions.
translation.landing.previewDashboardDesc: Daily financial summary with smart insights
translation.landing.previewStatsDesc: Pie, line, and bar charts with drill-down
translation.landing.previewWalletDesc: Multi wallets with real-time balance tracking
translation.landing.faq6Answer: Expend has a complete feature set: transaction tracking, multiple wallets, budget tracking, wallet transfers, interactive statistics charts, advanced search & filters, monthly reports with PDF export, and much more.
translation.landing.faq7Question: Can I import from other apps?
translation.landing.faq7Answer: Yes. Go to Settings > Data > Import JSON to import an Expend backup. Data from other apps must be converted to Expend's JSON backup format first.
translation.landing.faq9Answer: Yes. Expend automatically generates monthly reports at the beginning of each month (days 1-3). Reports include financial health score, category breakdown, spending trends, and can be downloaded as PDF.
translation.landing.faq10Question: How does swipe gesture work on mobile?
translation.landing.faq10Answer: On transaction cards on mobile, swipe left to delete and swipe right to edit. The card will snap back to its original position if not swiped far enough.
